verdict.rationale: Render is a cloud application platform, and comparable platforms can ship an AI model gateway, so this question applies to it. The pack contains no evidence of a unified gateway endpoint giving access to hundreds of models. The closest item is managed OIDC that lets Render services authenticate to Anthropic and OpenAI without long-lived keys. That is a related authentication feature, not a model gateway, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an ai-native builder, I can access hundreds of AI models through a single unified gateway endpoint
